headline: LLM-PowerTrace reports time-resolved GPU power data for AI compute
summary: An Oct. 28 arXiv preprint introduces LLM-PowerTrace, a reported collection of GPU power traces across fine-tuning and serving. The authors describe 1,788 fine-tuning runs and 405 inference runs on NVIDIA L40S, A100, H100 and H200 GPUs, with nominal 100 ms device telemetry, and report fitted mean-power errors in the low single digits on evaluated held-out regimes. They say the complete dataset will be released upon acceptance; the currently described explorer exposes selected reference traces. The preprint does not establish independent reproduction, facility-level energy measurement or grid effects.
